personality.blurb: Eva comes across as approachable and outreach-minded, comfortable presenting to both technical and lay audiences and actively volunteering to encourage others into engineering. She blends deep technical focus with wide-ranging curiosity—from chip design to AI safety to biomedical devices—and likely engages others through collaborative, knowledge-sharing conversations.
